decisions.reason: Removing Aave and its yield-related About-page copy does not change the Small Block prize rules or any Aave-related attribute in its current state.
The prize transfer, announcement, and wallet-destination rules are independent of Aave yield generation.
Removing Aave does not alter the amount, trigger, recipient, timing, or delivery of coded-referral commissions.
The Mission-page state contains no Aave integration or prize-pool yield copy requiring removal.
The current FAQ requirements do not mention Aave or prize-pool yield generation.
The Aave removal does not change the current or conditional future project names.
The newly specified hero copy and layout contain no Aave or yield-generation claim.
Integrating the book cover into the landing page is unrelated to the removed Aave integration.
Removing Aave yield generation does not entail that secondary royalties stop funding prize pools or change the royalty amount and allocation.
The Big Block state contains no Aave or yield-generation attribute, and its prize, draw, ticket, funding, and selection rules remain valid unchanged.
The deferred Discord community-server requirement is unrelated to Aave or prize-pool yield generation.
The Mauritius landing-page access restriction is unaffected by removal of the Aave integration.
